Generate.text:
You are executing a Graph-of-Thoughts molecular optimization operation.

Current graph operation:
Generate

Source molecule:
<SMILES> {source_smiles} </SMILES>

Optimization objective:
Improve all of the following target properties relative to the source molecule:
{goal_lines}

Constraints:
- Return exactly one candidate molecule.
- Return the molecule as a SMILES string enclosed in <SMILES> </SMILES> tags.
- Do not include explanations.
- Do not include multiple candidates.
- This node must be generated only from the source molecule and the current Generate operation.

Output format:
<SMILES> candidate_smiles_here </SMILES>

Refine.text:
You are executing a Graph-of-Thoughts molecular optimization operation.

Current graph operation:
Refine

Source molecule:
<SMILES> {source_smiles} </SMILES>

Parent node:
{parent_block}

Environment feedback:
{validity_note}

Optimization objective:
Improve all of the following target properties relative to the source molecule:
{goal_lines}

Instructions:
- Create exactly one refined molecular candidate.
- Use the parent node and the environment feedback.
- Prefer chemically plausible changes.
- Preserve useful similarity to the source molecule when possible.
- If the parent is invalid, repair it rather than copying it.
- Do not include explanations.
- Do not include multiple candidates.
- Return only one SMILES string enclosed in <SMILES> </SMILES> tags.
- This node must be generated only from the listed graph parent and the source molecule.

Output format:
<SMILES> candidate_smiles_here </SMILES>

Merge.text:
You are executing a Graph-of-Thoughts molecular optimization operation.

Current graph operation:
Merge

Source molecule:
<SMILES> {source_smiles} </SMILES>

Parent nodes to merge:
{parent_blocks}

Optimization objective:
Improve all of the following target properties relative to the source molecule:
{goal_lines}

Instructions:
- Create exactly one merged molecular candidate.
- Combine useful molecular ideas from the parent nodes.
- Do not concatenate molecules mechanically.
- Prefer a single chemically plausible analog.
- Preserve useful similarity to the source molecule when possible.
- Do not include explanations.
- Do not include multiple candidates.
- Return only one SMILES string enclosed in <SMILES> </SMILES> tags.
- This node must be generated only from the listed graph parents and the source molecule.

Output format:
<SMILES> candidate_smiles_here </SMILES>

Aggregate.text:
You are executing a Graph-of-Thoughts molecular optimization operation.

Current graph operation:
Aggregate

Source molecule:
<SMILES> {source_smiles} </SMILES>

Parent nodes to aggregate:
{parent_blocks}

Optimization objective:
Improve all of the following target properties relative to the source molecule:
{goal_lines}

Instructions:
- Create exactly one aggregated molecular candidate.
- Extract the strongest common or complementary design patterns from the parent nodes.
- Do not output a list.
- Do not copy an invalid parent unchanged.
- Prefer a single chemically plausible analog.
- Preserve useful similarity to the source molecule when possible.
- Return only one SMILES string enclosed in <SMILES> </SMILES> tags.
- This node must be generated only from the listed graph parents and the source molecule.

Output format:
<SMILES> candidate_smiles_here </SMILES>

validity_notes.valid: The parent candidate was RDKit-valid. Refine it to improve the molecular objectives while preserving useful structure.
validity_notes.invalid: The parent candidate was RDKit-invalid or had no canonical SMILES. Repair it into one valid molecular analog and improve the objectives.

prompt_contract.field_hash_encoding: json.dumps ensure_ascii=False separators=(comma,colon) sort_keys=False; UTF-8; no trailing LF

scorer_contract.normalization: min-max per UID G/stage; missing kernel0, constant finite0.5 when abs(hi-lo)<1e-12
scorer_contract.valid_completeness_precondition: canonical and finite all target comparison values, comparison SAS, raw binary Sim at BOTH stages; property_unavailable is not chemical_invalid
scorer_contract.arithmetic: binary64 start1; add weighted targets in registry order; Sim; SAS; duplicate
scorer_contract.tie: stable descending score on created_order ascending; exact equality; no score epsilon
scorer_contract.full_pool: all G+16 generated nodes; re-normalize; no backflow
scorer_contract.precision: internal Sim raw, internal targets/SAS comparison round2; source unchanged; final metrics comparison values

decoding_contract.stop: EOS or cap; no tag/Wait/stop_strings/forced EOS
decoding_contract.effective_configuration_to_record: complete per-call GenerationConfig.to_dict and other kwargs
